images.title: A regular hexagon of side 4 cm
images.purpose: Show a regular hexagon drawn by stepping the side length six times round a circle of the same radius.
images.composition: One circle centred in the frame with the hexagon inside it.
exact_structure: A grey (#6B7280) circle with centre O, labelled O, and one radius drawn and labelled 4 cm.
Exactly 6 small grey (#6B7280) arcs on the circle, each cut with the compass set to 4 cm, stepping round from the first point.
The 6 points joined in order by teal (#0072B2) segments to make a regular hexagon.
One side of the hexagon labelled 4 cm.
One corner of the hexagon with a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle arc labelled 120°.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The side length, stepped six times round a circle of that radius, closes the hexagon.
images.description: Show a regular hexagon drawn by stepping the side length six times round a circle of the same radius.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: The stepping round the circle is a construction students copy from the figure.
